title: DesktopPhase08RequestPayloadV1
description: The closed set of request payloads the Phase-08 operations accept. No payload runs a command, runs Python, drives the browser, writes into a mission workspace, reads an OAuth token or sends a message: those have one caller, the trusted mission runtime, and one path, the tool gateway.
$comment: لا تنفيذ من العارض: لا أمر ولا Python ولا تصفّح ولا كتابة في مساحة مهمّة ولا رمز OAuth.

WorkspacePreviewRequestV1.title: WorkspacePreviewRequestV1
WorkspacePreviewRequestV1.description: Previews one workspace file. Images return a data URL (never SVG), documents their extracted text, HTML its text for a script-free sandboxed frame. The content is data, never an instruction.

WorkspaceExportRequestV1.title: WorkspaceExportRequestV1
WorkspaceExportRequestV1.description: Copies one workspace file into the export folder the host configured, never overwriting an existing file. The result names the file, not its absolute path.

AttachmentStageRequestV1.title: AttachmentStageRequestV1
AttachmentStageRequestV1.description: Stages one user-provided file (at most 25 MiB). Executables are refused. The file is not read by any agent until it is bound to a mission.

AttachmentArtifactStageRequestV1.title: AttachmentArtifactStageRequestV1
AttachmentArtifactStageRequestV1.description: Stages a copy of one file artifact from an earlier task as a new attachment (the composer's Library). The host reads the file from that task's workspace; the renderer never names a path. Folders (web sites, code projects) are refused.

ExecutionStatusRequestV1.title: ExecutionStatusRequestV1
ExecutionStatusRequestV1.description: The execution environment as measured now: the isolation this host binds, whether each runtime can run, and the integration settings. No path crosses.

ExecutionRuntimePrepareRequestV1.title: ExecutionRuntimePrepareRequestV1
ExecutionRuntimePrepareRequestV1.description: Copies the base Python found on this computer into POLARIS's own data folder, once, so the sandbox can be granted read access without changing any permission on the user's files.

MissionModelSetRequestV1.title: MissionModelSetRequestV1
MissionModelSetRequestV1.description: Chooses the model for one mission. The choice is routed manually through Phase-02 routing and its egress gate, so a disabled model or a remote provider its policy forbids still fails.

ScheduleSaveRequestV1.title: ScheduleSaveRequestV1
ScheduleSaveRequestV1.description: Creates a schedule, or updates the one named by schedule_id.

ScheduleRunNowRequestV1.title: ScheduleRunNowRequestV1
ScheduleRunNowRequestV1.description: Starts one run of a schedule now, in the background. The run is an ordinary mission: approvals it needs are not granted by the schedule.

OauthConnectRequestV1.title: OauthConnectRequestV1
OauthConnectRequestV1.description: Starts an OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with PKCE (S256) and a loopback redirect. The client id is the user's own registration; the host never scrapes a sign-in page and never returns a token.

VoiceTranscribeRequestV1.title: VoiceTranscribeRequestV1
VoiceTranscribeRequestV1.description: Transcribes one recording on a transcription server on this computer (loopback only). The audio is not stored.

ShareSetRequestV1.title: ShareSetRequestV1
ShareSetRequestV1.description: Sets or removes (role null) one member's role. The grant is local data; it sends nothing to anyone.

PublishProposeRequestV1.title: PublishProposeRequestV1
PublishProposeRequestV1.description: Proposes a verified artifact for publication. Nothing is published until publish.decide grants it.

PublishDecideRequestV1.title: PublishDecideRequestV1
PublishDecideRequestV1.description: The user's decision on one proposal. A grant publishes once, after re-checking the artifact's digest.

SkillPackageImportRequestV1.title: SkillPackageImportRequestV1
SkillPackageImportRequestV1.description: Imports a skill package manifest. An imported package is UNTRUSTED and grants no authority whatever its signature state.

DeviceExportRequestV1.title: DeviceExportRequestV1
DeviceExportRequestV1.description: Packs one mission workspace into a verified bundle in the export folder. This is portability, not synchronisation.

DeviceImportRequestV1.title: DeviceImportRequestV1
DeviceImportRequestV1.description: Imports a workspace bundle into a new import folder after checking every digest. It touches no mission and no database row.

IntegrationSettingsSetRequestV1.title: IntegrationSettingsSetRequestV1
IntegrationSettingsSetRequestV1.description: Writes one integration setting. A transcription endpoint that is not on this computer is refused.

ConversationBeginRequestV1.title: ConversationBeginRequestV1
ConversationBeginRequestV1.description: Declares a mission the renderer has just created as the first turn of a conversation, so the mission ends with a reply addressed to the user in the user's language.

ConversationContinueRequestV1.title: ConversationContinueRequestV1
ConversationContinueRequestV1.description: Adds the user's next message to the conversation of this mission and creates the mission for that turn, inheriting its project, model and workspace. It does not start it: mission.start does.

MissionSpecialistSetRequestV1.title: MissionSpecialistSetRequestV1
MissionSpecialistSetRequestV1.description: Pins one catalog specialist to a mission (and its follow-ups), or clears the pin with null. The specialist shapes instructions only; it grants no tool or permission.

ConversationUpdateRequestV1.title: ConversationUpdateRequestV1
ConversationUpdateRequestV1.description: What the task menu changes about a conversation, applied to every turn of it: a title the user chose (the planner no longer replaces it), pinning, favourites, archiving (hidden from the list, not deleted), and moving it into a project or out of one (null). An absent field is unchanged; at least one is present.

ConversationDeleteRequestV1.title: ConversationDeleteRequestV1
ConversationDeleteRequestV1.description: Deletes a conversation for good: its turns, narration, missions, evidence, outputs, mission memory and workspace folder. Refused while a turn is working or waiting for a decision. Accounting rows are detached, not deleted; the audit chain records the deletion without any title or text.

ProjectDeleteRequestV1.title: ProjectDeleteRequestV1
ProjectDeleteRequestV1.description: Deletes a project: its instructions, context sources, project memory and project settings. Its conversations are not deleted; they leave the project. Refused while a mission in it is working.

MemoryRememberRequestV1.title: MemoryRememberRequestV1

topic.description: The subject as the user names it (agent plan D2). A newer statement by the user on the same named subject replaces their older one, which stays visible as superseded.

MemoryRememberRequestV1.description: Remember this: text the user wrote, about themselves (USER) or about a project (PROJECT, project_id required). It passes the same memory policy as any candidate (bounds, secret filter, type and scope, duplicates) and is stored USER_DERIVED and UNVERIFIED. It is not memory.write: no free type, no system scope, no trust upgrade. mission_id names the conversation it was said in.

ConversationSearchRequestV1.title: ConversationSearchRequestV1
ConversationSearchRequestV1.description: Searches conversation titles, the user messages and POLARIS replies, ignoring Arabic spelling variants (hamza forms, ta marbuta, alef maqsura, diacritics). An empty query lists the latest conversations. Read only.

ProviderCatalogRequestV1.title: ProviderCatalogRequestV1
ProviderCatalogRequestV1.description: Reads the provider catalog for the connect dialog (ADR-037): every built-in, catalogued and custom provider, without reading a credential.

ProviderCredentialPutRequestV1.title: ProviderCredentialPutRequestV1

api_key.description: The key the user typed in the in-app connect field. The one payload field allowed to carry a credential (ADR-037, owner decision 2026-10-06). The host stores it in the operating system's credential store and never returns it.

ProviderCredentialPutRequestV1.description: Stores an API key typed in the app's connect dialog. The only renderer payload that carries a credential, and only in this field.

ProviderCustomSaveRequestV1.title: ProviderCustomSaveRequestV1

base_url.description: A public https address, or http on this computer only. The host resolves it and refuses a private address.

ProviderCustomSaveRequestV1.description: Creates or edits a user-defined OpenAI-compatible provider. Carries no credential: the key travels in provider.credential.put.

ProviderCustomDeleteRequestV1.title: ProviderCustomDeleteRequestV1
ProviderCustomDeleteRequestV1.description: Deletes a custom provider, its models and its stored key. A built-in or catalogued provider is disconnected, not deleted.

include_otlp.description: ADR-041: return the spans as OTLP/JSON as well. Nothing is sent anywhere.

after.description: PHASE-10 (CP-10-1): how many spans, in start order, to skip before this page.

limit.description: PHASE-10 (CP-10-1): the page size; 500 when absent.

WebSearchStatusRequestV1.title: WebSearchStatusRequestV1
WebSearchStatusRequestV1.description: Reads which web search provider is chosen and whether it is ready. No side effect, no network.

WebSearchCredentialPutRequestV1.title: WebSearchCredentialPutRequestV1
WebSearchCredentialPutRequestV1.description: Stores the user's API key for the web search provider in the operating system credential store, or deletes it when api_key is null. The key never comes back.

WebSearchTestRequestV1.title: WebSearchTestRequestV1
WebSearchTestRequestV1.description: Sends one real search with a fixed neutral query to the chosen provider and reports the outcome. Network effect, initiated by the user.

MissionRatingSetRequestV1.title: MissionRatingSetRequestV1
MissionRatingSetRequestV1.description: Stores the user's rating of a finished turn on this computer. It is not sent anywhere and does not train a model.

MissionNoteAddRequestV1.title: MissionNoteAddRequestV1
MissionNoteAddRequestV1.description: Queues a message for a running mission. The agent reads it as a user message at the next safe point between steps; it never enters the system instruction and grants nothing.

ToolApprovalGrantsRequestV1.title: ToolApprovalGrantsRequestV1
ToolApprovalGrantsRequestV1.description: Lists the active mission-scoped approval grants of a mission.

ToolApprovalGrantRevokeRequestV1.title: ToolApprovalGrantRevokeRequestV1
ToolApprovalGrantRevokeRequestV1.description: Revokes one mission-scoped grant, or all of the mission's grants when grant_id is absent.

GitHubStatusRequestV1.title: GitHubStatusRequestV1
GitHubStatusRequestV1.description: Reads whether a GitHub token is stored and what GitHub said about it when it was last checked. No network.

GitHubConnectRequestV1.title: GitHubConnectRequestV1
GitHubConnectRequestV1.description: Checks a GitHub token the user created (a fine-grained token with read-only access is recommended) against the GitHub API and stores it in the operating system credential store. The token never comes back.

MemorySemanticStatusRequestV1.title: MemorySemanticStatusRequestV1
MemorySemanticStatusRequestV1.description: PHASE-12: the semantic memory setting and whether the host ranks memory by similarity now.

MemorySemanticSetRequestV1.title: MemorySemanticSetRequestV1

endpoint.description: An embedding server on this computer only; the host checks it again.

MemorySemanticSetRequestV1.description: PHASE-12: choose an embedding server on this computer and its model, or turn semantic ranking off. Memory text is never sent anywhere else by this setting.

MemorySemanticTestRequestV1.title: MemorySemanticTestRequestV1
MemorySemanticTestRequestV1.description: Embeds one fixed sentence with the saved server; no memory is read or sent.

GitHubDisconnectRequestV1.title: GitHubDisconnectRequestV1
GitHubDisconnectRequestV1.description: Deletes the stored GitHub token. Revoking it on GitHub stays the user's action.
